decision.recommended_plan: No tension between cost and retention here. The retention agent identified zero critical/underwater employees in this population, so there is no retention-driven urgency to weigh against cost's approach. Cost recommends day-one funding of NYX-001's 21,449.61 USD gap rather than phasing it, on administrative-simplicity grounds (a single employee, modest absolute dollar amount, not worth the overhead of tracking a second funding event a year out). Since retention has no position requiring day-one funding (there's no one underwater to protect), there's nothing for cost's timing choice to conflict with. Recommendation: proceed with cost's day-one funding of 21,449.61 USD for NYX-001.
